audit.summary: Three Major problems affect a core abstract theorem, normalization of the stated PNG equation, and a principal proof dependency. One Minor problem concerns the narrow-wedge initial velocity. Correctly normalized intended PNG results are not thereby refuted.
limitations: Limitations: Focused proof and counterexample review, not a certification of every argument on 71 pages.
Limitations: No complete repaired PNG theorem or replacement generator argument is proved.
Limitations: Bounded correction search did not identify an erratum; this is not proof of absence or priority.
Limitations: No author code was run; code absence is not a mathematical defect.
Limitations: Native helpers contributed bounded checks; no independent human acceptance or verified backend identity is claimed.
P1 — Counterevidence: The remaining inspected resolvent algebra is consistent conditional on the missing mixed identity; no failure of a strengthened theorem established.
P2 — Counterevidence: Half vector fields yield consistent normalization and are what the kernel calculation and scalar equation use.
P3 — Counterevidence: Invariant-measure-a.e. convergence may repair the shock limit. AppendixB.1 only establishes continuity from above and does not repair global C0 membership.
P4 — Counterevidence: The inspected Fredholm proof does not use this displayed initial velocity.
The finding applies to the exact reviewed source version and inspected scope; uninspected publication versions are not adjudicated.
The report retains counterevidence and unresolved questions. Publication does not repeat scientific review.
Independent human scientific adjudication remains pending; author adoption has not been requested.

proposition.claim:
Theorem 3.1 claims non-Abelian Toda for every interior index under shift and first derivative hypotheses.

Printed half-scaled light-cone coordinates are used with the quarter-sized mixed wave derivative and an unmodified Toda equation.

Prop4.6 spatial average f_epsilon belongs to C0 and its semigroup converges uniformly to the point probability.

Narrow-wedge initial distributional velocity is unqualified -2delta0.

repair.content:
Restrict to r>=lower+2, or supply mixed trace-norm identity at required indices. Restriction empties the three-level PNG application; actual PNG compatibility/forcing/regularity still requires proof.

Use half vector fields explicitly or rescale coordinates/mixed derivative consistently. Multipoint convention must also be made explicit.

Prove a valid generator-domain approximation or establish integrated/weak backward equation directly; justify convergence and domain separately.

State the height-dependent formula and specify scope of the general jump illustration.
